title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
title_zh: EgoWitness：第一人称视频流中的实例级空间记忆与推理基准
abstract_en: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.
abstract_zh: 要回答某件物体最后在何时、何地被谁看到，模型必须能跨日期、跨拍摄者认出同一件物体。现有长视频基准主要关注事件、物体类别或相对位置，对实例级空间记忆的评估仍然不足。为此，论文提出 EgoWitness，涵盖约 324 小时的整周及短时第一人称录像，包含 8,453 道经人工核验的问题，评估从识别物体与房间到回忆目击者、推理房间访问记录等七项能力。基准通过房间时间线关联逾百万个人工复核的掩码，覆盖 34 个已登记地标和 21 种可移动物体标签。在 12 个直接作答的视觉语言模型（VLM）中，开放权重模型的最高准确率为 46.97%，且所有模型在判断「最后是谁看到该物体」时的准确率均不超过 35%。论文进一步提出 EgoClue，通过五种工具检索候选视频片段、核验物体实例身份并计算时空关系。经监督微调（SFT）和组相对策略优化（GRPO）两阶段训练，其 4B 控制器在 1,320 道留出问题上的准确率从 23.64% 提升至 72.65%。综合证据链后，EgoClue 在整周录像问题上以 74.85% 的准确率追平最佳直接作答 VLM，并在训练未涵盖的环境中达到 80.56%。
key_points_zh: EgoWitness 用约 324 小时的第一人称录像和 8,453 道人工核验的问题评估七项能力，重点是跨日期、跨拍摄者追踪同一件物体，而非仅识别类别。
直接作答的开放权重 VLM 最高准确率为 46.97%；12 个受测 VLM 在判断最后目击者时均未超过 35%。
EgoClue 通过五种工具检索视频片段、核验实例身份并计算时空关系；SFT 与 GRPO 将其 4B 控制器在 1,320 道留出题上的准确率从 23.64% 提高到 72.65%。
综合证据链后，EgoClue 在整周录像问题上以 74.85% 追平最佳直接作答 VLM，在训练未涵盖的环境中达到 80.56%。
